notes: These cells are unfilled both in the historical appendix and in Lasry et al. Table 2 / Lasry dissertation Table 6.2, not merely unknown to the 1918 analysts. Baseline fills remain separate hypotheses unless an independent constraint supports them.

An illustrative square in paper Figure 2 / dissertation Figure 6.2 places VF=6 and XA=5, opposite the baseline fill. It also prints N twice (AX and XG), contradicting the final key table. Treat the two digits as unresolved, rather than elevating the inconsistent illustrative figure to an established key.

limits: The primary candidate retains MILB, 0RM and RELA without identifying an institution, unit or location.
The wording proposals MISSION, ABTLG and NACHRICHTENCHEF cost six observed-coordinate changes and two printed-mask fills; no source slot is inserted, excluded or reordered.
Reading the MILB B as separator X is a separately priced optional proposal, costing two further observed-coordinate substitutions.
The three remaining unknown positions use two globally coupled square cells. Their two completions are retained without choosing historical numerals.
The identified record is a service address and routing/signature fragment, not recovery of the unlocated second-part body.
